groups.name: dependency_topology_negative_controls

groups.name: exact_snapshot_and_content_identifiers

groups.name: undeclared_dependency_counterexample

groups.name: nonnegative_price_duality

groups.name: finite_price_polytope_extrema
groups.domain: Two-dimensional savings [-3,3]^2; three price vertices; every quarter-grid barycentric combination.

groups.name: strict_scalar_repayment_threshold

groups.name: weighted_model_prices_and_invalid_budgets

non_claims: No independent proof kernel or origin authentication.
